### $\lambda$ - System

:::{.definition data-title="$\lambda$-System"}

A **$\lambda$-system** on $\Omega$ is a set $D$ of subsets of $\Omega$
satisfying:
1. $\Omega \in D$;
2. $A \in D \implies \Omega \setminus A \in D$; and 
3. $A_{1}, A_{2}, \dots \in D$ and pairwise disjoint then
   $\bigcup_{n=1}^\infty A_{n}\in D$.

:::
